preconditions.description: n is an integer within the range [1, 10^5]

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' if any(any(a[i] * a[j] % n == 0 for j in range(i+1, n)) for i in range(n)) else return_value[0] == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The first line of output is 'YES' if there exists a permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] such that its prefix product sequence is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n-1]; otherwise, it is 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(return_value[i+1]) <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains an integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(int(return_value[i+1]) for i in range(n))) == n
postconditions.description: All integers in the next n lines are distinct.
